metadata.description: Master configuration for Return transactions generation, ensuring referential integrity with Orders and Order Details.

business_rules.name: Valid Return Origin
business_rules.logic: Returns can only be initiated for Orders where Order_Status == 'Delivered'.

business_rules.name: Refund Upper Bound
business_rules.logic: Refund_Amount MUST NEVER exceed the Final_Item_Price from order_details.

business_rules.name: Refund Status Synchronization
business_rules.logic: IF Return_Status IN ['Rejected', 'Pending'] THEN Refund_Amount MUST BE 0.0.

validation_rules: (Order_ID, Product_ID) combination must strictly exist in order_details.csv.
Order_ID must trace back to an order in orders.csv with Order_Status == 'Delivered'.
Refund_Amount must be exactly 0.0 if Return_Status is 'Rejected' or 'Pending'.
No negative values permitted in Refund_Amount.
No missing/NULL values in mandatory fields (Return_ID, Order_ID, Product_ID, Return_Date, Return_Reason, Return_Status, Refund_Amount).
